title: RSA-OAEP test: encrypt and decrypt oracles share code paths
description: test/wp11_test_pkcs11.c test_soft_rsa_oaep uses wc_RsaPublicEncrypt_ex() as the oracle for Part A and wp11_test_soft_rsa_oaep_decrypt() as the oracle for Part B. Both oracles live in the same codebase and share key-handling paths. If both have the same bug, the cross-validation passes. The oracle for RSA-OAEP should be an independent implementation (e.g., OpenSSL EVP_PKEY_encrypt) or known test vectors from NIST SP 800-56B.
